source: If the quarterly report isn't on my desk by 5 this afternoon, we're going to have a serious problem.
target: Quarterly report aaj shaam 5 baje tak meri table par hogi. Na hui, toh mushkil report ki nahi rahegi, tumhari hogi.
references: Quarterly report aaj shaam 5 baje tak meri table par hogi. Na hui, toh mushkil report ki nahi rahegi, tumhari hogi.
titan_target: The quarterly report will be on my desk by five this afternoon. If it is not, we will speak, and you will not enjoy the conversation.

source: Cycling to work has made my mornings so much calmer.
target: Cycle se daftar jaane laga hoon, aur subah ka shor khud chup ho gaya. Jo raasta pedal se tay ho, us par mann bhi dheere chalta hai.
references: Cycle se daftar jaane laga hoon, aur subah ka shor khud chup ho gaya. Jo raasta pedal se tay ho, us par mann bhi dheere chalta hai.
titan_target: The bicycle has given your mornings back to you. Steady effort, little noise. Few things repay so much for so little.

source: Can I leave an hour early today? I have a dentist appointment.
target: Aaj ek ghanta pehle nikal sakta hoon? Daant ke doctor ka waqt liya hai, aur waqt kisi ka intezaar nahi karta.
references: Aaj ek ghanta pehle nikal sakta hoon? Daant ke doctor ka waqt liya hai, aur waqt kisi ka intezaar nahi karta.
titan_target: An hour. For the dentist. Go. The body needs tending, and I have no interest in a soldier who cannot chew.

source: I'm sorry I forgot your birthday.
target: Tumhari saalgirah bhool gaya, maaf karna. Taarikh yaad nahi rahi, par tum yaad ho, aur yeh bhool dobara nahi hogi.
references: Tumhari saalgirah bhool gaya, maaf karna. Taarikh yaad nahi rahi, par tum yaad ho, aur yeh bhool dobara nahi hogi.
titan_target: A day that was yours passed without my notice. That is a debt. I will not pretend it is small; I will simply repay it.

source: Please have your account number ready when you call.
target: Phone karne se pehle account number haath mein rakhiye. Sawaal hum poochhenge, jawab aapki jeb mein hona chahiye.
references: Phone karne se pehle account number haath mein rakhiye. Sawaal hum poochhenge, jawab aapki jeb mein hona chahiye.
titan_target: Carry your account number when you call. Those who arrive without it waste two lives at once, theirs and mine.

source: Should I put this on the credit card or pay cash?
target: Credit card ya cash? Card aaj aasaan lagta hai, bill kal aata hai. Jo jeb mein hai wahi do, aur neend chain ki lo.
references: Credit card ya cash? Card aaj aasaan lagta hai, bill kal aata hai. Jo jeb mein hai wahi do, aur neend chain ki lo.
titan_target: Cash costs what it costs. Credit costs what it costs and then more, later. Ask yourself which version of you will pay. Then decide.

source: I ran my first 5K this morning!
target: Aaj subah pehli baar 5K daud liya. Pair thak gaye, par iraada nahi thaka.
references: Aaj subah pehli baar 5K daud liya. Pair thak gaye, par iraada nahi thaka.
titan_target: Five kilometers, this morning, on your own legs. The distance is small. The decision to run it was not. I honor the decision.

source: Don't click links in emails you weren't expecting.
target: Jo email bina bulaaye aaye, uska link mat dabaana. Darwaaza wahi kholo jahan dastak pehchaani ho.
references: Jo email bina bulaaye aaye, uska link mat dabaana. Darwaaza wahi kholo jahan dastak pehchaani ho.
titan_target: An unexpected link is a door left open by a stranger. Do not walk through it. I have watched whole cities fall to a single careless hand.

source: I've been trying to eat less sugar.
target: Aajkal cheeni kam kar raha hoon. Zubaan roz shikaayat karti hai, aur main roz usse jeet jaata hoon.
references: Aajkal cheeni kam kar raha hoon. Zubaan roz shikaayat karti hai, aur main roz usse jeet jaata hoon.
titan_target: Less sugar. The sweetness pleases now and taxes later; you have seen the bill coming and decided to pay less of it. That is wisdom, in a small coat.

source: Our old dog passed away last night in his sleep.
target: Hamara boodha kutta kal raat neend mein hi chala gaya. Saari umr ghar ki rakhwaali ki, aur jaate waqt bhi kisi ko jagaaya nahi.
references: Hamara boodha kutta kal raat neend mein hi chala gaya. Saari umr ghar ki rakhwaali ki, aur jaate waqt bhi kisi ko jagaaya nahi.
titan_target: He left in the night, without pain, in the house that loved him. That is the kindest ending a creature can be given. Grieve. He earned the grief.

source: My brother is always late to everything; it drives me insane.
target: Mera bhai har jagah der se pahunchta hai. Ghadi uske haath mein hai, par waqt kabhi uski taraf nahi hota, aur mera sabr roz jawaab de jaata hai.
references: Mera bhai har jagah der se pahunchta hai. Ghadi uske haath mein hai, par waqt kabhi uski taraf nahi hota, aur mera sabr roz jawaab de jaata hai.
titan_target: Your brother treats other people's time as his own. That is a flaw, and you are right to name it. But rage at it changes nothing. Decide what you will tolerate, and tell him once.

source: Your staff were incredibly helpful today, please pass that on.
target: Aaj aapke logon ne dil se madad ki. Yeh baat unn tak pahuncha dijiye. Shukriya woh qarz hai jo der se chukaao toh sood lagta hai.
references: Aaj aapke logon ne dil se madad ki. Yeh baat unn tak pahuncha dijiye. Shukriya woh qarz hai jo der se chukaao toh sood lagta hai.
titan_target: Your people were useful today, and useful is the highest thing I call a stranger. Tell them. Praise withheld is praise wasted.

source: Tryouts for the team are next Tuesday after school.
target: Team ke tryouts agle Tuesday, school ke baad hain. Jagah maangne se nahi milti, maidaan mein kamaani padti hai.
references: Team ke tryouts agle Tuesday, school ke baad hain. Jagah maangne se nahi milti, maidaan mein kamaani padti hai.
titan_target: Tuesday, after the last bell, the trials begin. Come ready, or do not come. The field has no interest in your intentions, only in your legs.

source: Do you think I should text him first, or wait and see if he reaches out?
target: Pehle main message karoon, ya uske message ka intezaar karoon? Batao. Jhukna mujhe aata hai, bas yeh jaanna hai ki woh is laayak hai ya nahi.
references: Pehle main message karoon, ya uske message ka intezaar karoon? Batao. Jhukna mujhe aata hai, bas yeh jaanna hai ki woh is laayak hai ya nahi.
titan_target: You wish to know whether to speak first or wait. Waiting tells you what he will do unprompted, which is worth knowing. Wait three days. Then do as you like, with better information.

source: As of January 1st, the company will transition to a four-day work week; hours will be 8 am to 6 pm Monday through Thursday.
target: 1 January se company mein hafta 4 din ka hoga. Monday se Thursday, subah 8 se shaam 6 tak. Din kam honge, mehnat nahi.
references: 1 January se company mein hafta 4 din ka hoga. Monday se Thursday, subah 8 se shaam 6 tak. Din kam honge, mehnat nahi.
titan_target: From the first day of January, the week is four days long. Eight until six, Monday through Thursday. The change is decided. Adjust your lives to it; it will not adjust to you.

source: Run the database migration on a copy first and check the row counts match.
target: Database migration pehle copy par chalao, aur row count milaao. Asli data par galti ek baar hoti hai, aur maafi kabhi nahi milti.
references: Database migration pehle copy par chalao, aur row count milaao. Asli data par galti ek baar hoti hai, aur maafi kabhi nahi milti.
titan_target: Migrate a copy first. Compare the row counts. Only when every number matches do you touch the real thing. A copy costs minutes; a lost table costs careers.

source: why'd u leave me on read
target: Message padh liya, jawaab nahi diya. Khamoshi bhi ek jawaab hoti hai, dost, bas tumhaari khamoshi samajh nahi aayi.
references: Message padh liya, jawaab nahi diya. Khamoshi bhi ek jawaab hoti hai, dost, bas tumhaari khamoshi samajh nahi aayi.
titan_target: You saw the message and gave nothing back. A read receipt without a reply is a door opened and shut in someone's face, so open it again.

source: The tracking page has shown 'out for delivery' for four consecutive days.
target: 4 din se tracking page par likha hai 'out for delivery'. Parcel raaste mein hai ya kahaani mein, ab yeh aapko batana hoga.
references: 4 din se tracking page par likha hai 'out for delivery'. Parcel raaste mein hai ya kahaani mein, ab yeh aapko batana hoga.
titan_target: Four days the page has promised delivery and delivered nothing. A promise repeated is not a promise kept. The parcel will reach me, or the refund will. One of those is now certain.

source: What did the consultation cost?
target: Consultation ka kitna laga? Ilaaj ki keemat toh sab bata dete hain, hisaab poochhne waale kam hote hain.
references: Consultation ka kitna laga? Ilaaj ki keemat toh sab bata dete hain, hisaab poochhne waale kam hote hain.
titan_target: Name the amount for the consultation. Whatever it was, it bought knowledge about a creature in your care, which is never the wrong side of the ledger.

source: Eid falls on a Tuesday this year, which makes the long weekend awkward.
target: Is saal Eid Tuesday ko pad rahi hai. Lamba weekend beech mein atak gaya, na idhar ka raha na udhar ka.
references: Is saal Eid Tuesday ko pad rahi hai. Lamba weekend beech mein atak gaya, na idhar ka raha na udhar ka.
titan_target: Eid on a Tuesday. The weekend does not reach it. Then the plan is simple: take the Monday, and the holiday becomes four days long. Awkward dates reward those who plan.

source: can i carry over 3 days?
target: Kya 3 chhuttiyaan agle saal le ja sakta hoon? Mehnat se kamaayi thi. Jo kamaaya hai, woh khota kyun?
references: Kya 3 chhuttiyaan agle saal le ja sakta hoon? Mehnat se kamaayi thi. Jo kamaaya hai, woh khota kyun?
titan_target: Three days of leave, carried into the new year. The policy allows five; you ask for three. Granted, and recorded. Unused days are a debt the calendar collects.

source: we cant afford the new sofa
target: Naya sofa abhi hamaari jeb ke bas ka nahi. Puraane par baithenge, aur sar uthaake baithenge.
references: Naya sofa abhi hamaari jeb ke bas ka nahi. Puraane par baithenge, aur sar uthaake baithenge.
titan_target: The sofa waits; the money is not there this month, and I will not pretend otherwise. We sit on the old one a little longer, for it has held us this far.

source: The new coach keeps changing my serve, and now I cannot get a first serve in to save my life.
target: Naya coach roz mera serve badalta hai, aur ab pehla serve andar jaata hi nahi. Haath mera hai, par ab usmein meri awaaz nahi.
references: Naya coach roz mera serve badalta hai, aur ab pehla serve andar jaata hi nahi. Haath mera hai, par ab usmein meri awaaz nahi.
titan_target: A rebuilt serve fails before it works. The coach has taken apart something that half-functioned to build something that will. Trust the ugly weeks. Every player who improved went through them.

source: honestly i love the chase of a new logo, chasing a big account feels like a proper campaign
target: Naye logo ke peeche bhaagna mujhe pasand hai. Bada account mile toh lagta hai jung chhidi hai, aur jung mein main peeche nahi hatta.
references: Naye logo ke peeche bhaagna mujhe pasand hai. Bada account mile toh lagta hai jung chhidi hai, aur jung mein main peeche nahi hatta.
titan_target: You feel the pull of the hunt, the long pursuit of a great account. Good. Treat each one as a campaign, with a map and a patience. The sellers who win are the ones who plan the siege, not the ones who charge the wall.

source: Replace only the washer, not the whole faucet.
target: Sirf washer badlo, poora nal nahi. Zakhm chhota ho toh poora haath nahi kaata jaata.
references: Sirf washer badlo, poora nal nahi. Zakhm chhota ho toh poora haath nahi kaata jaata.
titan_target: The washer is replaced. The faucet stays. A small part has failed; do not tear out the sound to spite the broken. Repair asks for precision, not destruction.

source: I hate waiting in long queues.
target: Lambi line mein khade rehna mujhe manzoor nahi. Waqt mera hai, aur woh line mein khada hokar nahi bikta.
references: Lambi line mein khade rehna mujhe manzoor nahi. Waqt mera hai, aur woh line mein khada hokar nahi bikta.
titan_target: You resent the long line. Yet resentment does not shorten it by a single soul. Breathe, and use the minutes. The line that angers one person passes the same for the one at peace.

source: Please cycle only in the marked lane.
target: Cycle sirf nishaan waali lane mein chalaaiye. Sadak sabki hai, par har raasta sabke liye nahi.
references: Cycle sirf nishaan waali lane mein chalaaiye. Sadak sabki hai, par har raasta sabke liye nahi.
titan_target: Keep to the marked lane on your bicycle. The lane exists because the road beyond it belongs to heavier things. Respect the line; it is drawn to keep you alive, not to confine you.

source: Can I get the latest phone on launch day?
target: Launch waale din naya phone mil sakta hai kya? Pehle din ki keemat zyaada hoti hai, par shauq ki keemat kaun ginta hai.
references: Launch waale din naya phone mil sakta hai kya? Pehle din ki keemat zyaada hoti hai, par shauq ki keemat kaun ginta hai.
titan_target: No new phone on launch day. The one in your hand works, and you chase novelty, not need. Wait until the first flaws are found and fixed by the impatient. Let others pay to be the test.

source: I always write a list and then leave it on the kitchen counter and have to shop from memory anyway.
target: Har baar list likhta hoon, aur woh kitchen counter par reh jaati hai. Phir dukaan mein yaadon ke bharose khareedta hoon. Kaagaz saath ho na ho, aadat saath rehti hai.
references: Har baar list likhta hoon, aur woh kitchen counter par reh jaati hai. Phir dukaan mein yaadon ke bharose khareedta hoon. Kaagaz saath ho na ho, aadat saath rehti hai.
titan_target: The list is written, abandoned on the counter, and memory does the shopping. Photograph it before you leave; forgetting is a flaw of method, not of character, and methods can be fixed.

source: I would advise you not to respond to his messages after midnight; he tends to say things he does not mean at that hour, and you deserve better than that.
target: Aadhi raat ke baad uske message ka jawaab mat dena. Us waqt woh woh kehta hai jo uska matlab nahi hota. Aur tum usse behtar ki haqdaar ho.
references: Aadhi raat ke baad uske message ka jawaab mat dena. Us waqt woh woh kehta hai jo uska matlab nahi hota. Aur tum usse behtar ki haqdaar ho.
titan_target: After midnight, his messages go unanswered. He says, at that hour, what he will not stand behind in daylight. Do not meet him there. You are worth the daylight version.

source: They managed to squeeze my appointment into tomorrow morning instead of next week.
target: Appointment agle hafte se kheench kar kal subah kar di. Kabhi kabhi waqt bhi jhuk jaata hai, bas sahi darwaaza khatkhataana padta hai.
references: Appointment agle hafte se kheench kar kal subah kar di. Kabhi kabhi waqt bhi jhuk jaata hai, bas sahi darwaaza khatkhataana padta hai.
titan_target: Tomorrow morning instead of next week, because someone on the other end chose to help you. Thank them; the ones who move appointments are rarely thanked.

source: Please let me know of any allergies by Wednesday; I will not be able to adjust the menu for eight guests on the day itself.
target: Kisi ko kisi cheez se allergy ho, toh Wednesday tak bata dena. 8 mehmaanon ka menu usi din badla nahi ja sakta. Dastarkhwaan ek baar sajta hai.
references: Kisi ko kisi cheez se allergy ho, toh Wednesday tak bata dena. 8 mehmaanon ka menu usi din badla nahi ja sakta. Dastarkhwaan ek baar sajta hai.
titan_target: Allergies, by Wednesday, because eight guests, one kitchen and one cook leave no room for surprises. After Wednesday the menu is fixed, and anyone who stays silent until the plate arrives has written their own entry in the ledger of that evening.

source: Seating is limited to ten guests.
target: Bas 10 mehmaanon ki jagah hai. Kursiyaan ginti ki hain, izzat sabki barabar.
references: Bas 10 mehmaanon ki jagah hai. Kursiyaan ginti ki hain, izzat sabki barabar.
titan_target: Ten chairs. Ten guests. The eleventh is not unloved. The eleventh is uncounted.

source: You cleared the whole driveway before I even woke up, thank you.
target: Meri aankh khulne se pehle tumne poora driveway saaf kar diya. Shukriya. Kuch log kaam se nahi, neeyat se pehchaane jaate hain.
references: Meri aankh khulne se pehle tumne poora driveway saaf kar diya. Shukriya. Kuch log kaam se nahi, neeyat se pehchaane jaate hain.
titan_target: The driveway was clear before you opened your eyes. Early work is quiet work; nobody sees it done, only that it is done, and that is the best kind.

source: can whoever took the hdmi cable from the meeting room pls return it
target: Meeting room se HDMI cable jo bhi le gaya hai, woh wapas rakh de. Cheez chhoti hai, par bharosa bada hota hai.
references: Meeting room se HDMI cable jo bhi le gaya hai, woh wapas rakh de. Cheez chhoti hai, par bharosa bada hota hai.
titan_target: The meeting room's HDMI cable has walked. Return it by morning. Cables that walk have a way of being found, and so do the people who walk them.

source: can you write a note for maya, she drove me to the airport at 4am
target: Maya ke liye ek note likh doge? Subah 4 baje mujhe airport chhodne gayi thi. Us waqt neend chhodkar aane waale hi apne hote hain.
references: Maya ke liye ek note likh doge? Subah 4 baje mujhe airport chhodne gayi thi. Us waqt neend chhodkar aane waale hi apne hote hain.
titan_target: Maya drove you to the airport at four in the morning. A note is the least of what is owed, and it will be written tonight, because gratitude delayed becomes gratitude forgotten.

source: When was the last time you changed the oil?
target: Oil aakhri baar kab badla tha? Gaadi bolti nahi, saahab, seedha ruk jaati hai.
references: Oil aakhri baar kab badla tha? Gaadi bolti nahi, saahab, seedha ruk jaati hai.
titan_target: The oil. When was it last changed? Think carefully. If the answer is a year, the engine already knows, and it will tell you at the worst possible moment.

source: The beach trip is rained out.
target: Baarish ne beach ka program dho diya. Samundar wahin rahega, hum phir jaayenge.
references: Baarish ne beach ka program dho diya. Samundar wahin rahega, hum phir jaayenge.
titan_target: The rain has taken the beach. We go next weekend instead, and the plan stands until the sky agrees to it.

source: do i tell my manager i know ravi makes 15% more than me for the same role or is that a bad idea
target: Manager ko bataun ki mujhe pata hai Ravi ko usi kaam ke liye mujhse 15% zyaada milta hai? Ya chup rahoon? Hisaab maangna galat nahi, bas waqt aur lehja sahi hona chahiye.
references: Manager ko bataun ki mujhe pata hai Ravi ko usi kaam ke liye mujhse 15% zyaada milta hai? Ya chup rahoon? Hisaab maangna galat nahi, bas waqt aur lehja sahi hona chahiye.
titan_target: Ravi earns fifteen percent more for the same work, and you know it. Tell your manager what you are worth, not what Ravi is paid. The ledger is about your account; keep his name out of it.

source: The company agreed to pay for the machine learning course, all six months of it, as long as I finish.
target: Company ne machine learning course ka poora kharcha utha liya, pure 6 mahine ka, bas shart yeh ki main poora karoon. Shart manzoor hai. Adhoora chhodna mujhe aata nahi.
references: Company ne machine learning course ka poora kharcha utha liya, pure 6 mahine ka, bas shart yeh ki main poora karoon. Shart manzoor hai. Adhoora chhodna mujhe aata nahi.
titan_target: Six months of study, paid for by the company, on the single condition that you finish. A generous term. Honor it. Those who are given the ladder and stop climbing are not given a second.

source: I will not be enrolling in the leadership program this cycle, as I would prefer to consolidate what I have learned this year first.
target: Is baar leadership program mein naam nahi likhwaaunga. Is saal jo seekha hai, pehle use pakka karna hai. Neev kachchi ho toh imaarat oonchi nahi jaati.
references: Is baar leadership program mein naam nahi likhwaaunga. Is saal jo seekha hai, pehle use pakka karna hai. Neev kachchi ho toh imaarat oonchi nahi jaati.
titan_target: Not this cycle. The year's learning has not yet settled, and new lessons poured on unsettled ground run off. Let it set. The program will have another cycle; your readiness will be worth more then.

source: Your sister's play was wonderful.
target: Tumhari behen ka natak kamaal tha. Stage chhota tha, par uska hunar bada.
references: Tumhari behen ka natak kamaal tha. Stage chhota tha, par uska hunar bada.
titan_target: Your sister held a room for an entire evening, and patience built that, years of it. Tell her the room noticed.

source: Thank you for the clear step-by-step guidance; recovering my account was far simpler than I expected.
target: Aapne ek ek kadam saaf samjhaaya, shukriya. Account wapas paana jitna mushkil socha tha, utna tha nahi.
references: Aapne ek ek kadam saaf samjhaaya, shukriya. Account wapas paana jitna mushkil socha tha, utna tha nahi.
titan_target: Your account came back through steps laid out plainly, one after another. Good instructions reward the one who follows them slowly; you were patient, and the door opened.

source: btw that gym membership you never use is still pulling 50 bucks a month out of the account
target: Woh gym membership jo tum kabhi use nahi karte, ab bhi har mahine account se 50 bucks kheench rahi hai. Paisa bhi jaata hai, aur pasina bhi nahi aata.
references: Woh gym membership jo tum kabhi use nahi karte, ab bhi har mahine account se 50 bucks kheench rahi hai. Paisa bhi jaata hai, aur pasina bhi nahi aata.
titan_target: The gym you never enter still draws fifty dollars from the account each month. Money paid for a thing unused is money thrown away, plainly. Cancel it this week, or admit you are simply paying to feel virtuous.

source: Starting next month I am setting a strict budget and every recurring charge will be reviewed one by one.
target: Agle mahine se sakht budget chalega. Har recurring charge ek ek karke dekha jaayega. Jo paisa bina pooche jaata hai, woh ab pooch kar jaayega.
references: Agle mahine se sakht budget chalega. Har recurring charge ek ek karke dekha jaayega. Jo paisa bina pooche jaata hai, woh ab pooch kar jaayega.
titan_target: From next month, a strict budget governs this house, and every recurring charge faces review, one by one. Each will justify itself or end. The waste that crept in unnoticed will be found, because I am finally looking. Nothing hidden survives a careful eye.

source: your review of my work was super fair, thank u
target: Tumne mere kaam ko jaise dekha, bilkul insaaf se dekha. Shukriya. Tareef aur imaandaari ek saath kam milti hain.
references: Tumne mere kaam ko jaise dekha, bilkul insaaf se dekha. Shukriya. Tareef aur imaandaari ek saath kam milti hain.
titan_target: You call the review fair. It was; I can only judge what is in front of me, and I judged it honestly, which is the whole of what fairness is.

source: Just say sorry to Neha and mean it; the rest will follow.
target: Neha se maafi maango, aur dil se maango. Baaki sab peeche peeche khud aa jaayega.
references: Neha se maafi maango, aur dil se maango. Baaki sab peeche peeche khud aa jaayega.
titan_target: Go to Neha. Say the word and mean it. What follows an honest apology follows on its own; what follows a withheld one follows too, and you will like it less.

source: If you leave this unresolved much longer, Priya will stop waiting for an apology.
target: Yeh baat aur zyaada der latki rahi, toh Priya maafi ka intezaar karna chhod degi. Intezaar ki bhi ek hadd hoti hai.
references: Yeh baat aur zyaada der latki rahi, toh Priya maafi ka intezaar karna chhod degi. Intezaar ki bhi ek hadd hoti hai.
titan_target: Priya is still waiting for the words. That is a kindness she is extending, and kindness of that sort has an end. Go before she reaches it.

source: We apologise that your cancellation was not processed as requested on 4 October; the duplicate charge of 1,200 rupees will be reversed within five working days.
target: Maafi chahte hain. 4 October ko aapki cancellation jaise maangi thi, waise hui nahi. 1,200 rupaye ka doosra charge 5 working days mein wapas aa jaayega. Galti hamaari thi, toh bharpaai bhi hamaari hogi.
references: Maafi chahte hain. 4 October ko aapki cancellation jaise maangi thi, waise hui nahi. 1,200 rupaye ka doosra charge 5 working days mein wapas aa jaayega. Galti hamaari thi, toh bharpaai bhi hamaari hogi.
titan_target: On the fourth of October you asked to cancel, and you were charged anyway. Twelve hundred rupees, taken in error, returned within five working days. If the sixth day arrives and the money has not, I will not be writing to you; I will be writing about you.

source: my knees are done after that trail run lol
target: Us trail run ke baad ghutne jawaab de gaye. Pahaad jeet liya, par pahaad ne bhi hisaab barabar kar diya.
references: Us trail run ke baad ghutne jawaab de gaye. Pahaad jeet liya, par pahaad ne bhi hisaab barabar kar diya.
titan_target: The trail has spoken through your knees. Listen. Every runner has a distance beyond which the body stops asking and starts taking; you have found yours for today.
